items.title: Automatic login after reset leaves the attacker's or victim's other sessions alive
Reset link may be reusable because nothing says the token is consumed on use
Reset link stays valid for a full day, so a stolen link takes over the account
Reset token travels in the URL and leaks through history, referrers and logs
Reset token can be guessed or brute forced over a 24 hour window
Reset request reveals whether an email address has an account
Unauthenticated reset endpoint can be scripted to flood inboxes and burn email quota
